method: Viewed all seven original screenshots after capture; same before/after cameras and current frontend.
observations: Context view shows replacement of five-storey closed cylinder by lower open stair; annex footprint and roof remain.
Close view shows curved landings, alternating flights, thin canopy, columns and three bridges meeting glazed host doorways.
Trees-on state retains original foreground tree and partial occlusion; tree-off state checks the underlying geometry.
Mobile portrait with collapsed panel shows complete stair silhouette and bridges at base detail.
Old close view clips the top of the taller cylinder; old context view covers its full height.
Night state preserves open stair shape.
limitations: Dimensions and hidden arrangement are photo-constrained estimates.
Ground approach beyond the circular platform and annex remaining facades are pending.
Screenshots do not establish physical safety compliance or true-device performance.
